Enhancing Graviton–Photon Conversion through Galactic Magnetic Turbulence Hongliang Tian,1 Lei Wu,1,2 Yang Zhang,3 Bin Zhu4 1 Department of Physics and Institute of Theoretical Physics, Nanjing Normal University, Nanjing, 210023, China 2 Nanjing Key Laboratory of Particle Physics and Astrophysics, Nanjing, 210023, China 3 Center for Theoretical Physics, Henan Normal University, Xinxiang 453007, China 4 School of Physics, Yantai University, Yantai 264005, China This Supplemental Material presents the theoretical framework and uncertainty analysis for graviton-photon conversion in Galactic magnetic turbulence. We first derive the weak-mixing conversion amplitude and the projected magnetic power spectrum, and examine the dependence on the turbulent spectral index. We then describe the finite path calculation and derive the conversion probabilities in the low mismatch, inertial range, and high mismatch regimes.
